summary: A Mosman family practice with implants, sedation and sleep apnoea care is a strength, but booking buttons that only go to a contact page and visible developer text appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Every BOOK ONLINE button appears to go to the contact page, not a booking tool, and the Holiday Hours banner appears to link to the contact page with no hours shown.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book online have to wait for a reply.
findings.fix: A real online booking calendar and clear holiday hours.

findings.problem: The Email Us link, Cookies link and read disclaimer link appear to point to #, and the contact form appears to show the text 'Leave this empty:'.
findings.cost: Dead links and visible developer text look unfinished.
findings.fix: Working links and a hidden anti spam field.

findings.problem: 'Advance Treatments' appears instead of Advanced Treatments, the FAQ about emergency dental services appears twice, and a stray number appears at the top of the page.
findings.cost: Typos and repeats make a clinic look careless.

findings.problem: Only two testimonials appear and the dentists appear only as menu links with no credentials or introductions.
findings.cost: New patients want to know who will treat them.
findings.fix: Dentist profiles with credentials and more reviews.

redesign: Working links and hidden spam field.
Proofread copy, dentist profiles and reviews.
